local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local SoundService = game:GetService("SoundService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

--==================================================
-- GUI SETUP
--==================================================
local screenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
screenGui.Name = "ClientAudioControl"
screenGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
screenGui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local frame = Instance.new("Frame")
frame.Name = "MainFrame"
frame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 360, 0, 390)
frame.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -180, 0.5, -195)
frame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
frame.BorderSizePixel = 3
frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
frame.Parent = screenGui

--==================================================
-- DRAGGING
--==================================================
local dragging = false
local dragStart
local startPosition

local function updateDrag(input)
    local delta = input.Position - dragStart
    frame.Position = UDim2.new(
        startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X,
        startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y
    )
end

frame.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
    if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
        dragging = true
        dragStart = input.Position
        startPosition = frame.Position
        input.Changed:Connect(function()
            if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
                dragging = false
            end
        end)
    end
end)

game:GetService("UserInputService").InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
    if dragging and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
        updateDrag(input)
    end
end)

--==================================================
-- TITLE
--==================================================
local titleLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
titleLabel.Name = "Title"
titleLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40)
titleLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 5)
titleLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
titleLabel.Text = "FE Audio Controller GUI"
titleLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
titleLabel.TextSize = 22
titleLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
titleLabel.Parent = frame

--==================================================
-- RESPECT FILTERING ENABLED LABEL
--==================================================
local filteringLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
filteringLabel.Name = "RespectFilteringEnabled"
filteringLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30)
filteringLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 45)
filteringLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
filteringLabel.TextSize = 18
filteringLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
filteringLabel.Parent = frame

--==================================================
-- RESPECT FILTERING NOTIFICATION GENERATOR
--==================================================
local debounce = false
local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

local function runWarningNotification()
    if debounce then return end
    debounce = true

    -- Create the dynamic Warning TextLabel
    local warningLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    warningLabel.Name = "FilteringWarningNotification"
    warningLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0, 400, 0, 80)
    warningLabel.Position = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.1, 0) -- Starts off-screen right
    warningLabel.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
    warningLabel.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    warningLabel.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    warningLabel.BorderSizePixel = 3
    warningLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    warningLabel.TextSize = 14
    warningLabel.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
    warningLabel.TextWrapped = true
    warningLabel.Text = "RespectFilteringEnabled is enabled so this means this script will be fully visual and check the script description for more info!"
    warningLabel.Parent = screenGui

    -- Slide In Animation
    local slideIn = TweenService:Create(warningLabel, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0)})
    slideIn:Play()
    slideIn.Completed:Wait()

    -- Display Hold Time
    task.wait(8)

    -- Slide Out Animation
    local slideOut = TweenService:Create(warningLabel, tweenInfo, {Position = UDim2.new(1, 450, 0.1, 0)})
    slideOut:Play()
    slideOut.Completed:Wait()

    -- Cleanup
    warningLabel:Destroy()
    debounce = false
end

local function updateFilteringLabel()
    local value = SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled
    filteringLabel.Text = "RespectFilteringEnabled = " .. tostring(value)
    
    if value then
        filteringLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0) -- TRUE = RED
    else
        filteringLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0) -- FALSE = GREEN
    end
end

updateFilteringLabel()

-- Add these 3 lines here so it only triggers once on startup:
if SoundService.RespectFilteringEnabled then
    task.spawn(runWarningNotification)
end

--==================================================
-- BUTTON CREATION
--==================================================
local function createButton(name, text, yPosition)
    local button = Instance.new("TextButton")
    button.Name = name
    button.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 42)
    button.Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, yPosition)
    button.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 0)
    button.BorderSizePixel = 3
    button.BorderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    button.Text = text
    button.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
    button.TextSize = 18
    button.Font = Enum.Font.Legacy
    button.Parent = frame
    return button
end

local playButton   = createButton("PlayAllButton", "Play All", 82)
local stopButton   = createButton("StopAllButton", "Stop All", 128)
local pauseButton  = createButton("PauseAllButton", "Pause All", 174)
local loopButton   = createButton("LoopButton", "Loop All", 220)
local spamButton   = createButton("SpamButton", "Spam All", 266)
local lockButton   = createButton("LockButton", "Loop Stop All", 312)

--==================================================
-- SOUND FUNCTIONS
--==================================================
local function getAllSounds()
    local sounds = {}
    for _, object in ipairs(game:GetDescendants()) do
        if object:IsA("Sound") then
            table.insert(sounds, object)
        end
    end
    return sounds
end

local savedPositions = {}

local function stopAllSounds()
    for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
        sound:Stop()
    end
end

-- BUTTON 1: PLAY ALL
playButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
        sound:Play()
    end
end)

-- BUTTON 2: STOP ALL
stopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    stopAllSounds()
end)

-- BUTTON 3: PAUSE / RESUME
local paused = false
pauseButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if not paused then
        savedPositions = {}
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            savedPositions[sound] = sound.TimePosition
            sound:Stop()
        end
        paused = true
        pauseButton.Text = "Unpause All"
    else
        for sound, position in pairs(savedPositions) do
            if sound and sound.Parent and sound:IsA("Sound") then
                sound.TimePosition = position
                sound:Play()
            end
        end
        paused = false
        pauseButton.Text = "Pause All"
    end
end)

-- BUTTON 4: TOGGLE LOOPED
local loopEnabled = false
loopButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    loopEnabled = not loopEnabled
    for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
        sound.Looped = loopEnabled
    end
    loopButton.Text = loopEnabled and "Unloop All" or "Loop All"
end)

-- BUTTON 5: SPAM ALL AUDIOS
local spamEnabled = false
local function spamSounds()
    while spamEnabled do
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            sound:Play()
        end
        task.wait(0.05)
        if not spamEnabled then break end
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            sound:Stop()
        end
        task.wait(0.01)
    end
end

spamButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    spamEnabled = not spamEnabled
    if spamEnabled then
        spamButton.Text = "Unspam All"
        task.spawn(spamSounds)
    else
        spamButton.Text = "Spam All"
    end
end)

-- BUTTON 6: PERSISTENT STOP
local persistentStop = false
local persistentConnection
local function startPersistentStop()
    if persistentConnection then persistentConnection:Disconnect() end
    persistentConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not persistentStop then return end
        for _, sound in ipairs(getAllSounds()) do
            if sound.IsPlaying then
                sound:Stop()
            end
        end
    end)
end

lockButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    persistentStop = not persistentStop
    if persistentStop then
        lockButton.Text = "Unloop Stop All"
        stopAllSounds()
        startPersistentStop()
    else
        lockButton.Text = "Loop Stop All"
        if persistentConnection then
            persistentConnection:Disconnect()
            persistentConnection = nil
        end
    end
end)

-- DETECT NEW SOUNDS
game.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(object)
    if object:IsA("Sound") and persistentStop then
        task.defer(function()
            if object.Parent and persistentStop then
                object:Stop()
            end
        end)
    end
end)

-- KEEP FILTERING LABEL UPDATED
task.spawn(function()
    while screenGui.Parent do
        updateFilteringLabel()
        task.wait(1)
    end
end)

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then

				-- Skip characters/NPCs
				local parentModel = part:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

				if not (
					parentModel
						and parentModel:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
					) then

					-- Remove existing decals
					for _, child in ipairs(part:GetChildren()) do
						if child:IsA("Decal") then
							child:Destroy()
						end
					end

					-- Add decal to all six faces
					for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
						local decal = Instance.new("Decal")

						decal.Name = "VataDecal"
						decal.Texture = decalTextureId
						decal.Face = face
						decal.Transparency = 0

						decal.Parent = part
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- SKY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Sky", function()
		local skyTextureId = "rbxassetid://71869538800676"

		-- Remove old skies
		for _, obj in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if obj:IsA("Sky") then
				obj:Destroy()
			end
		end

		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")

		sky.Name = "VataSky"
		sky.SkyboxBk = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxDn = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxFt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxLf = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxRt = skyTextureId
		sky.SkyboxUp = skyTextureId

		sky.Parent = Lighting
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- FLIP GRAVITY
	--==================================================

	addButton("Flip Gravity", function()
		if workspace.Gravity == 196.2 then
			workspace.Gravity = -196.2
		else
			workspace.Gravity = 196.2
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- RANDOM TELEPORT ALL
	--==================================================

	addButton("Random Teleport All", function()
		for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if p.Character then
				local root = p.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")

				if root then
					root.CFrame = CFrame.new(
						math.random(-100, 100),
						math.random(10, 50),
						math.random(-100, 100)
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- EXPLOSIVE ORBS
	--==================================================

	addButton("Spawn Explosive Orbs", function()
		local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

		if not camera then
			return
		end

		for i = 1, 10 do
			local orb = Instance.new("Part")

			orb.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
			orb.Size = Vector3.new(3, 3, 3)
			orb.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
			orb.BrickColor = BrickColor.Random()
			orb.Anchored = false
			orb.CanCollide = false

			orb.Position = camera.CFrame.Position + Vector3.new(
				math.random(-15, 15),
				math.random(10, 20),
				math.random(-15, 15)
			)

			orb.Name = "ExplosiveOrb"
			orb.Parent = workspace

			local bodyVelocity = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")

			bodyVelocity.Velocity = Vector3.new(
				math.random(-20, 20),
				math.random(10, 30),
				math.random(-20, 20)
			)

			bodyVelocity.P = 5000
			bodyVelocity.MaxForce = Vector3.new(
				10000,
				10000,
				10000
			)

			bodyVelocity.Parent = orb

			Debris:AddItem(orb, 10)
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- NIGHT VISION
	--==================================================

	local nightVisionEnabled = false

	addButton("Toggle Night Vision", function()
		local blur = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VataNightVisionBlur")
		local cc = Lighting:FindFirstChild("VataNightVisionColor")

		if nightVisionEnabled then

			if blur then
				blur.Enabled = false
			end

			if cc then
				cc.Enabled = false
			end

			nightVisionEnabled = false

		else

			if not blur then
				blur = Instance.new("BlurEffect")
				blur.Name = "VataNightVisionBlur"
				blur.Parent = Lighting
			end

			blur.Size = 3
			blur.Enabled = true

			if not cc then
				cc = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")
				cc.Name = "VataNightVisionColor"
				cc.Parent = Lighting
			end

			cc.TintColor = Color3.fromRGB(100, 255, 100)
			cc.Brightness = 0.15
			cc.Contrast = 0.1
			cc.Enabled = true

			nightVisionEnabled = true
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- MUSIC
	--==================================================

	local musicPlaying = false
	local musicSound

	addButton("Toggle Music", function()
		if not musicSound then
			musicSound = Instance.new("Sound")

			musicSound.Name = "VataMusic"
			musicSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
			musicSound.Looped = true
			musicSound.Volume = 1
			musicSound.Parent = workspace

			local distortion1 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
			distortion1.Level = 1
			distortion1.Parent = musicSound
		end

		if musicPlaying then
			musicSound:Stop()
			musicPlaying = false
		else
			musicSound:Play()
			musicPlaying = true
		end
	end)
	
	addButton("Anonymus", function()
		-- Looping Anonymous Sound (Começa aos 9 segundos + Distorção)
		local Spooky1 = Instance.new("Sound")
		Spooky1.Parent = workspace
		Spooky1.Name = "Anonymousshii"
		Spooky1.SoundId = "rbxassetid://1840712882"
		Spooky1.Volume = 10
		Spooky1.Looped = true

		local distortion1 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
		distortion1.Level = 1
		distortion1.Parent = Spooky1

		Spooky1.Loaded:Wait()
		Spooky1.TimePosition = 8.6
		Spooky1:Play()

		-- Apply Decal to All Sides
		local decalId = "rbxassetid://127476787"

		local function applyDecalToAllSides(part)
			local faces = {
				Enum.NormalId.Top,
				Enum.NormalId.Bottom,
				Enum.NormalId.Left,
				Enum.NormalId.Right,
				Enum.NormalId.Front,
				Enum.NormalId.Back
			}

			for _, face in ipairs(faces) do
				local decal = Instance.new("Decal")
				decal.Texture = decalId
				decal.Face = face
				decal.Parent = part
			end
		end

		for _, part in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if part:IsA("BasePart") then
				applyDecalToAllSides(part)
			end
		end

		-- Skybox
		local skyId = "rbxassetid://18876121366"

		local sky = Instance.new("Sky")
		sky.SkyboxBk = skyId
		sky.SkyboxDn = skyId
		sky.SkyboxFt = skyId
		sky.SkyboxLf = skyId
		sky.SkyboxRt = skyId
		sky.SkyboxUp = skyId
		sky.Parent = game.Lighting

		-- Fog
		local lighting = game.Lighting
		lighting.FogColor = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
		lighting.FogStart = 0
		lighting.FogEnd = 300

		-- Repeating Sound Every 10 Seconds
		task.spawn(function()
			while true do
				local repeatSound = Instance.new("Sound")
				repeatSound.Parent = workspace
				repeatSound.Name = "RepeatingSound"
				repeatSound.SoundId = "rbxassetid://0"
				repeatSound.Volume = 10
				repeatSound.Looped = false

				local distortion2 = Instance.new("DistortionSoundEffect")
				distortion2.Level = 0.99
				distortion2.Parent = repeatSound

				repeatSound.Loaded:Wait()
				repeatSound.TimePosition = 9
				repeatSound:Play()

				repeatSound.Ended:Connect(function()
					repeatSound:Destroy()
				end)

				task.wait(10)
			end
		end)

		-- Modifica todas as partes
		local function exPro(root)
			for _, v in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				if v:IsA("BasePart") then
					v.Material = Enum.Material.Plastic
					v.Transparency = 1
					v.Locked = false
				end
				exPro(v)
			end
		end

		local function asdf(root)
			for _, v in ipairs(root:GetChildren()) do
				asdf(v)
			end
		end

		exPro(workspace)
		asdf(workspace)

		-- Example:
		local part = Instance.new("Part")
		part.Size = Vector3.new(5, 5, 5)
		part.Position = Vector3.new(0, 10, 0)
		part.Anchored = true
		part.Parent = workspace
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- JUMPSCARE
	--==================================================

	local jumpscareActive = false
	local jumpscareImage

	addButton("Jumpscare", function()
		if jumpscareActive then
			return
		end

		jumpscareActive = true

		jumpscareImage = Instance.new("ImageLabel")

		jumpscareImage.Name = "JumpscareImage"
		jumpscareImage.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
		jumpscareImage.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 0)
		jumpscareImage.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
		jumpscareImage.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		jumpscareImage.Image = "rbxassetid://70979457873034"
		jumpscareImage.ScaleType = Enum.ScaleType.Stretch
		jumpscareImage.ZIndex = 1000
		jumpscareImage.Parent = gui

		task.delay(2, function()
			if jumpscareImage then
				jumpscareImage:Destroy()
				jumpscareImage = nil
			end

			jumpscareActive = false
		end)
	end)
	
	addButton("Particles", function()
		local character = player.Character
		if not character then
			return
		end

		local root = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not root then
			return
		end

		local attachment = Instance.new("Attachment")
		attachment.Name = "VataParticlesAttachment"
		attachment.Parent = root

		local particles = Instance.new("ParticleEmitter")
		particles.Name = "VataParticles"
		particles.Texture = "73859504735494"
		particles.Rate = 100
		particles.Lifetime = NumberRange.new(1, 2)
		particles.Speed = NumberRange.new(3, 8)
		particles.SpreadAngle = Vector2.new(360, 360)
		particles.Rotation = NumberRange.new(0, 360)
		particles.RotSpeed = NumberRange.new(-180, 180)
		particles.LightEmission = 1
		particles.Size = NumberSequence.new({
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.5),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 1),
			NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)
		})

		particles.Color = ColorSequence.new({
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.25, Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.75, Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 255))
		})

		particles.Parent = attachment

		Debris:AddItem(attachment, 10)
	end)
	
	--==================================================
	-- CLOSE/OPEN GUI
	--==================================================

	toggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		mainFrame.Visible = not mainFrame.Visible

		if mainFrame.Visible then
			toggleBtn.Text = "Close GUI"
		else
			toggleBtn.Text = "Open GUI"
		end
	end)

	--==================================================
	-- KEYBIND: RIGHT SHIFT
	--==================================================

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gameProcessed)
		if gameProcessed then
			return
		end

		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.RightShift then
			mainFrame.Visible = not mainFrame.Visible

			if mainFrame.Visible then
				toggleBtn.Text = "Close GUI"
			else
				toggleBtn.Text = "Open GUI"
			end
		end
	end)
end

--==================================================
-- PLAYER SETUP
--==================================================

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(player)
	player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	createGui(player)
end)

for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
	if player.Character then
		createGui(player)
	end
end
